6a52c4ab: What does the Pro plan add?
3b28e7d0: Extra features: dynamic pricing, email marketing and automations, custom domain, your colours and logo, multiple organisations and roles, no Evoly branding. And a commission capped at €0.70 per ticket, instead of €1 on Free.
9cf52d18: When do I get my money?
8cb6462b: Payments go through Stripe. Your sales revenue is paid into your bank account via your Stripe account, according to its payout schedule.
2fbc7d28: How does the 14-day Pro trial work?
dbad2623: You get every Pro feature for 14 days. A bank card is required to start. Unless you cancel before the trial ends, the subscription moves to €29 per month.
6c5b8b33: Can I cancel at any time?
d4874c8f: Yes. The Free plan is free with no commitment, and you can cancel the Pro plan whenever you like from your dashboard. You then move back to the Free plan.
4175588d: How do I set up my custom domain?
c815aed5: With the Pro plan, add your domain (for example tickets.mysite.com) from your dashboard, then point it to Evoly with your domain registrar. The SSL certificate is activated automatically.
19fe3abb: Every ticket carries a QR code. On the day, you scan entries with the built-in scanner, installable on any phone, with haptic feedback on every scan. Your volunteers get a temporary link and scan without creating an account. Manual entry and statistics are included.
59ba0e63: What happens if I cancel an event?
689334aa: You cancel from your dashboard and your attendees are notified by email. Paid tickets are refunded via Stripe.
0eecfc18: How is it different from HelloAsso?
be05c3df: HelloAsso is reserved for associations and is funded by a voluntary contribution suggested to your attendees at checkout. Evoly is for every organiser, everywhere, with a simple commission, capped at €1 per ticket and included in the price.
